lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,221 hero damage a minute, more than 81% of Sparrow carry players this patch (41% of the team's). The damage came from Necrosis, Lightning Hawk, Imperator.
Necrosis (Necro's Edge): Gain 25 Ultimate Haste.
Necrosis (Matter Disruptor): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Sparrow dealt 42,726 hero damage, 41% of their team's, with +267 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Drongo (level 17: about 160 physical armor, 108 after penetration; took 11,956 physical damage from heroes, 62% of all hero damage they took) and Greystone (level 18: about 205 physical armor, 141 after penetration; took 14,449 physical damage from heroes, 45% of all hero damage they took) that is about 25% and 26% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Necrosis (item): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Eviscerator (crest): Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Breach (Eternal minor): Ultimate damage reduces an Enemy Hero's Physical Armor by 35% for 4s.
Sustain: 7% lifesteal; 1,472 healing recorded.

Lesson: Sparrow's penetration cut through: Drongo took about 25% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 their armor was about 160, about 108 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).
